title: Ammonium Bromatum
text: This remedy is characterized by its action on the respiratory organs and the nervous system. It is useful in cases of chronic catarrh and chronic cough. There is a general feeling of irritation and burning. It is also useful in cases of nervous disorders, such as epilepsy and hysteria. Headache, with a sensation of weight in the forehead. Vertigo. Eyes red and burning. Itching of the eyelids. Chronic catarrh of the nose. Dryness and obstruction. Sneezing. Irritation and rawness in the throat. Hawking of mucus. Cough. Sensation of a lump in the throat. Appetite poor. Nausea. Burning in the stomach. Distended and tender. Flatulence. Shortness of breath. Wheezing. Violent cough, with a sensation of oppression in the chest. Hoarseness. Compare: Kali bromatum; Bromium; Hyoscyamus. First to third trituration.
